prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make an ORIGINAL game character SHOOTING ANIMATION sprite sheet matching the supplied reference character exactly: same short brown hair, ochre jacket, dark shirt, blue-gray trousers, brown boots, olive backpack, dark chunky outline, same overhead 2.5D view and pixel scale. Reference image is identity/style reference only, NOT an edit target. Create a NEW transparent PNG sheet, exactly FOUR ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS, sixteen completely separate full-body poses in equal cells with wide empty gutters. Row 1 facing DOWN toward viewer; row 2 facing RIGHT; row 3 facing UP away from viewer; row 4 facing LEFT. Every row is one short firing cycle with a compact dark rifle held with BOTH hands at chest height: columns 1 steady aim; 2 firearm kicks backward into shoulder with slight upper body recoil; 3 recoil settling; 4 steady aim recovered. Feet remain planted in the identical stance within each row: NO walking, jumping, stepping or changing leg length. Rifle remains aimed in the row direction, only subtle shoulder/elbow/rifle recoil between columns. For DOWN aim, show foreshortened rifle pointing downward on image; for UP aim barrel points upward past shoulder, visible beyond head side; side views show horizontal barrel. Keep head, torso and backpack same size in all 16 poses. Genuine bold low-resolution pixel-art clusters like the supplied sheet, not realism. Actual transparent background, no checkerboard, no ground, no shadow, no text, no labels, NO muzzle flashes or smoke baked into sheet (game adds those). No floating disconnected objects, no extra arms, no cropped weapons or feet, no touching sprites. Crisp dark outlines and warm earthy palette.

background_extraction_attempt.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied sixteen-frame shooting sheet. Remove ALL of the gray and white checkerboard completely, replacing it with real transparent alpha. The checkerboard must NOT be rendered into RGB pixels. Keep every character, rifle, black outline, pixel, pose, placement, dimensions and color exactly as-is. Output an RGBA PNG with genuinely transparent background, including the small gaps around arms, guns and between legs. Do not redraw or move the characters. No text, no new elements.

registration: Source RGB sheet preserved unchanged. Runtime menu_actor_palette shader keys its neutral background only for the shoot clip; matching mask used to measure 16 connected silhouettes. No background pixels are drawn in the menu.
